violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. Roasted eggplant that was cooked the day prior was temping at 54 at time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT ALL FOOD THAT IS COOKED AND COOLED MUST BE COOLED FROM 135F TO 70F IN TWO HOURS AND THEN TO 41 IN THE REMINDER OF 6 HOURS. THE ROASTED EGGPLANT HAD NOT COOLED PROPERLY BASED ON THOSE PARAMETERS. PIC THREW AWAY THE ROASTED EGGPLANT THAT DID NOT COOL PROPERLY.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Cooked sausage crumbles (48), garlic and herb butter (55), and cooked tomato sauce with beef (48) in the 3DR prep top unit was not cold holding properly.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT ALL COLD FOOD MUST BE COLD HELD AT 41F OR BELOW TO PREVENT THE POTENTIAL OF BACTERIA TO GROW. PIC THREW AWAY IMPLICATED FOODS. BERTUCCI'S (Inspection Date: 12/20/2024) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were found subject to contamination after receipt and during storage due to the condition as described: The ice machine in the back of the house was dirty and multiple pieces of ice in the machine had specks of black and brown frozen into them.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT THE ICE MACHINE NEEDS TO BE CLEANED PROPERLY TO PREVENT ICE BEING MADE WITH DIRT AND DEBRIS. PIC TURNED OFF THE ICE MACHINE IN ORDER TO DRAIN IT AND PROPERLY CLEAN THE MACHINE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: The 3DR prep top was not holding a proper temperature of 41F or below. The 3DR prep unit was temping at 45 degrees at the time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT ALL COLD HOLDING UNITS MUST BE HOLDING THE CORRECT TEMPERATURE OF 41 DEGREES OR BELOW. PIC SAID THEY WILL CALL THEIR MAINTENANCE COMPANY TO TAKE A LOOK AT THE EQUIPMENT.
